description: AI-native BuildOS for Codex, Claude Code, Doubao, WorkBuddy and ZCode: product discovery, UI/UX design, software engineering, context-aware workflows, testing, Git and verifiable releases.

summary.zh: 明确 Agent 不应迎合用户或因问法变化无依据改口：先依据项目事实独立判断并说明实质分歧与利弊，再按不触碰安全红线的知情决定和授权行动。
summary.en: Make independent professional judgment explicit: agents assess proposals against project facts, explain material disagreements and tradeoffs, and then follow informed decisions and authorization unless a safety boundary blocks them.
summary.ja: 独立した専門判断を明示しました。Agent は案をプロジェクト事実に照らして評価し、実質的な相違と利害を説明したうえで、安全境界に反しない知情後の決定と権限に従います。
